'''Hado Gwin''' was a [[Twi'lek]] [[Gender|male]] who spent several [[Standard year|years]] training at the [[Dette Lawnic Dance Academy]] with his partner [[Boshti Anilee]]. The couple then joined the competitive dancing circuit and won trophies in three [[sector]]s. The pair followed the [[yacht]] ''[[First Light]]''—a vessel belonging to [[Dryden Vos]], leader of the criminal [[Crimson Dawn]]—from port to port<ref name="SoloOG" /> and in [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events on the ''[[First Light]]'' in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' to nine years after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the formation of the Empire to [[19 BBY]], therefore the events on the ''First Light'' in ''Solo'' must take place in [[10 BBY]].</ref> he and Anilee were on board the yacht when it arrived on the [[planet]] [[Vandor]] and danced to a performance by singers [[Aurodia Ventafoli]] and [[Luleo Primoc]].<ref name="Solo" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hado Gwin first appeared in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="Solo" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloOG" />
